channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Magnitude 6.1 quake hits off Tokyo, but no tsunami alert issued
item.description: The shallow quake hit at 7:39 pm in the sea off the coast of the country's Kanto region, the Japan Meteorological Agency said on its website.

item.title: Okinawa Policy Council meeting held for first time in 13 years
item.description: The meeting was arranged in response to a request Okinawa Gov. Genta Koja made after winning the prefecture's gubernatorial election in September.

item.title: Sumo set to end 2026 on high note as stars align ahead of Kyushu basho
item.description: Sumo's ideal scenario is a pair of yokozuna going into the final day unbeaten and facing off with the Emperor's Cup at stake.

item.title: Kozo Tashima looking to bring ‘integrity’ to FIFA with run for president
item.description: The 68-year-old is set to become the first person from Japan to run for the FIFA presidency

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
